svg.title: Loud Bloom — clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: Original sweary floral poster with bold decorative lettering. Click a numbered region to toggle its suggested color. Shift-click paints every region with the same number.
svg.metadata: {"slug": "loud-bloom", "title": "Loud Bloom", "desc": "Original sweary floral poster with bold decorative lettering.", "tags": ["Adult", "Phrase", "Floral", "OurSpace Original"], "palette": [{"hex": "#FFF0B8", "name": "Cream"}, {"hex": "#FFD166", "name": "Coral"}, {"hex": "#F4A261", "name": "Sage"}, {"hex": "#E76F51", "name": "Pine"}, {"hex": "#D1495B", "name": "Ochre"}, {"hex": "#B23A6F", "name": "Clay"}, {"hex": "#7A5195", "name": "Mist"}, {"hex": "#4D5D9A", "name": "Blush"}, {"hex": "#457B9D", "name": "Espresso"}, {"hex": "#2A9D8F", "name": "Sand"}, {"hex": "#84C7A5", "name": "Sea Glass"}, {"hex": "#F7C59F", "name": "Ember"}, {"hex": "#FF8FA3", "name": "Porcelain"}, {"hex": "#C44569", "name": "Moss"}, {"hex": "#8F2D56", "name": "Berry"}, {"hex": "#F6BD60", "name": "Marigold"}, {"hex": "#F28482", "name": "Violet"}, {"hex": "#F5CAC3", "name": "Lagoon"}, {"hex": "#84A59D", "name": "Honey"}, {"hex": "#52796F", "name": "Mauve"}, {"hex": "#354F52", "name": "Leaf"}, {"hex": "#E9C46A", "name": "Poppy"}, {"hex": "#E56B6F", "name": "Sky"}, {"hex": "#6D597A", "name": "Umber"}, {"hex": "#6D597A", "name": "Extra tone 25"}], "complexity": "Detailed"}
